meta.title: Codename Griffin II
meta.description: Take up your fated weapon and protect the same person.

units.rawText: You're really handing this squad to me?
units.displayText: You're really handing this squad to me?

spans.text: You're really handing this squad to me?

units.rawText: You'll have more room to perform with their cooperation, no?
units.displayText: You'll have more room to perform with their cooperation, no?

spans.text: You'll have more room to perform with their cooperation, no?

units.rawText: Hmph, I can perfectly command even a group of normal Agents.
units.displayText: Hmph, I can perfectly command even a group of normal Agents.

spans.text: Hmph, I can perfectly command even a group of normal Agents.

units.rawText: But you are right. This is the most fitting squad for me on the cloud.
units.displayText: But you are right. This is the most fitting squad for me on the cloud.

spans.text: But you are right. This is the most fitting squad for me on the cloud.

units.rawText: I will leave their training and choice of designation to you, then. The new 404, maybe?
units.displayText: I will leave their training and choice of designation to you, then. The new 404, maybe?

spans.text: I will leave their training and choice of designation to you, then. The new 404, maybe?

units.rawText: Hah... absolutely not. I think there's only one name that truly fits this squad...
units.displayText: Hah... absolutely not. I think there's only one name that truly fits this squad...

spans.text: Hah... absolutely not. I think there's only one name that truly fits this squad...

units.rawText: <size=40>Griffin Squad, proceeding with operation phase 1. Prepare for combat!</size>
units.displayText: Griffin Squad, proceeding with operation phase 1. Prepare for combat!

spans.text: Griffin Squad, proceeding with operation phase 1. Prepare for combat!

units.rawText: The silver-haired Doll pulls the trigger on her grenade launcher, putting an end to the jellyfish without hesitation.
units.displayText: The silver-haired Doll pulls the trigger on her grenade launcher, putting an end to the jellyfish without hesitation.

spans.text: The silver-haired Doll pulls the trigger on her grenade launcher, putting an end to the jellyfish without hesitation.

units.rawText: The jellyfish's death does not impede the other Entropics at all. They charge towards Clukay, heedless of their own casualties.
units.displayText: The jellyfish's death does not impede the other Entropics at all. They charge towards Clukay, heedless of their own casualties.

spans.text: The jellyfish's death does not impede the other Entropics at all. They charge towards Clukay, heedless of their own casualties.

units.rawText: Looks like the target's here. IDW, do as you will.
units.displayText: Looks like the target's here. IDW, do as you will.

spans.text: Looks like the target's here. IDW, do as you will.

units.rawText: Got it, nya!
units.displayText: Got it, nya!

spans.text: Got it, nya!

units.rawText: A nimble figure dashes forth from behind Clukay, weaving between the Entropics as her high fire rate SMG spews forth lead.
units.displayText: A nimble figure dashes forth from behind Clukay, weaving between the Entropics as her high fire rate SMG spews forth lead.

spans.text: A nimble figure dashes forth from behind Clukay, weaving between the Entropics as her high fire rate SMG spews forth lead.

units.rawText: Nya, nya!
units.displayText: Nya, nya!

spans.text: Nya, nya!

units.rawText: This is the power of the IDW that the Professor gave me!
units.displayText: This is the power of the IDW that the Professor gave me!

spans.text: This is the power of the IDW that the Professor gave me!

units.rawText: Croak—
units.displayText: Croak—

spans.text: Croak—

units.rawText: You're far too slow to catch Betty!
units.displayText: You're far too slow to catch Betty!

spans.text: You're far too slow to catch Betty!

units.rawText: The SMG's firepower is only enough to clear out the lowest order of Entropics, making little headway against the Entropized and armored Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: The SMG's firepower is only enough to clear out the lowest order of Entropics, making little headway against the Entropized and armored Sanctifiers.

spans.text: The SMG's firepower is only enough to clear out the lowest order of Entropics, making little headway against the Entropized and armored Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: In the act of pursuing the agile Betty, the Entropic mass begins to fluctuate.
units.displayText: In the act of pursuing the agile Betty, the Entropic mass begins to fluctuate.

spans.text: In the act of pursuing the agile Betty, the Entropic mass begins to fluctuate.

units.rawText: Gr G36, Type 97, disrupt their formation.
units.displayText: Gr G36, Type 97, disrupt their formation.

spans.text: Gr G36, Type 97, disrupt their formation.

units.rawText: Jiangyu! Prepare for entry!
units.displayText: Jiangyu! Prepare for entry!

spans.text: Jiangyu! Prepare for entry!

units.rawText: Leave it to me! I'll be done in a flash!
units.displayText: Leave it to me! I'll be done in a flash!

spans.text: Leave it to me! I'll be done in a flash!

units.rawText: Two figures, red and yellow respectively, dive into the flanks of the Entropic formation.
units.displayText: Two figures, red and yellow respectively, dive into the flanks of the Entropic formation.

spans.text: Two figures, red and yellow respectively, dive into the flanks of the Entropic formation.

units.rawText: <size=40>Screech!!</size>
units.displayText: Screech!!

spans.text: Screech!!

units.rawText: Hehe, you'll be hitting your own with those tentacles if you flail around like that.
units.displayText: Hehe, you'll be hitting your own with those tentacles if you flail around like that.

spans.text: Hehe, you'll be hitting your own with those tentacles if you flail around like that.

units.rawText: She deftly avoids the attacks as the three-section staff in her hand puts down swathes of Low Order Entropics.
units.displayText: She deftly avoids the attacks as the three-section staff in her hand puts down swathes of Low Order Entropics.

spans.text: She deftly avoids the attacks as the three-section staff in her hand puts down swathes of Low Order Entropics.

units.rawText: With broad strokes, Jiangyu remains untouchable in the middle of the Entropic horde.
units.displayText: With broad strokes, Jiangyu remains untouchable in the middle of the Entropic horde.

spans.text: With broad strokes, Jiangyu remains untouchable in the middle of the Entropic horde.

units.rawText: Centaureissi takes a more precise approach, with every single bullet accurately finding a vulnerability.
units.displayText: Centaureissi takes a more precise approach, with every single bullet accurately finding a vulnerability.

spans.text: Centaureissi takes a more precise approach, with every single bullet accurately finding a vulnerability.

units.rawText: Your weaknesses are all too obvious...
units.displayText: Your weaknesses are all too obvious...

spans.text: Your weaknesses are all too obvious...

units.rawText: Screech!
units.displayText: Screech!

spans.text: Screech!

units.rawText: Centaureissi leaps into the air, plunging the blade in her hand into the core of an Entropic attempting a surprise attack.
units.displayText: Centaureissi leaps into the air, plunging the blade in her hand into the core of an Entropic attempting a surprise attack.

spans.text: Centaureissi leaps into the air, plunging the blade in her hand into the core of an Entropic attempting a surprise attack.

units.rawText: It is a maid's duty to take out the trash. Who's next?
units.displayText: It is a maid's duty to take out the trash. Who's next?

spans.text: It is a maid's duty to take out the trash. Who's next?

units.rawText: With staff, blade, claw and fire, the Low Order Entropics are swiftly eviscerated. The Entropic body begins to fall apart as the three mobile Dolls rip and tear.
units.displayText: With staff, blade, claw and fire, the Low Order Entropics are swiftly eviscerated. The Entropic body begins to fall apart as the three mobile Dolls rip and tear.

spans.text: With staff, blade, claw and fire, the Low Order Entropics are swiftly eviscerated. The Entropic body begins to fall apart as the three mobile Dolls rip and tear.

units.rawText: (Croaking)
units.displayText: Croaking

spans.text: Croaking

units.rawText: <size=40>SCREE!</size>
units.displayText: SCREE!

spans.text: SCREE!

units.rawText: Lacking the necessary mental faculties, the Low Order Entropics become entangled with each other. The Entropic group's locomotion slows greatly, and they even begin to gnaw at each other.
units.displayText: Lacking the necessary mental faculties, the Low Order Entropics become entangled with each other. The Entropic group's locomotion slows greatly, and they even begin to gnaw at each other.

spans.text: Lacking the necessary mental faculties, the Low Order Entropics become entangled with each other. The Entropic group's locomotion slows greatly, and they even begin to gnaw at each other.

units.rawText: Gr G36, Type 97, search for the target. IDW, stay safe and continue harassing them. Type 95, lay down cover!
units.displayText: Gr G36, Type 97, search for the target. IDW, stay safe and continue harassing them. Type 95, lay down cover!

spans.text: Gr G36, Type 97, search for the target. IDW, stay safe and continue harassing them. Type 95, lay down cover!

units.rawText: Roger. Jiangyu, Centaureissi, and Betty, smoke screen on the way.
units.displayText: Roger. Jiangyu, Centaureissi, and Betty, smoke screen on the way.

spans.text: Roger. Jiangyu, Centaureissi, and Betty, smoke screen on the way.

units.rawText: Woah! Thanks, Sis~
units.displayText: Woah! Thanks, Sis~

spans.text: Woah! Thanks, Sis~

units.rawText: Excuse us, then.
units.displayText: Excuse us, then.

spans.text: Excuse us, then.

units.rawText: Gr MG36, Lewis, LWMMG, suppressing fire.
units.displayText: Gr MG36, Lewis, LWMMG, suppressing fire.

spans.text: Gr MG36, Lewis, LWMMG, suppressing fire.

units.rawText: No problem! They won't get through us!
units.displayText: No problem! They won't get through us!

spans.text: No problem! They won't get through us!

units.rawText: It's almost like spraying into a crowd of zombies in a B-movie... I'd like to try an RPG one day.
units.displayText: It's almost like spraying into a crowd of zombies in a B-movie... I'd like to try an RPG one day.

spans.text: It's almost like spraying into a crowd of zombies in a B-movie... I'd like to try an RPG one day.

units.rawText: Watch your ammo count.
units.displayText: Watch your ammo count.

spans.text: Watch your ammo count.

units.rawText: With the combined arms of machine gun and assault rifle, the line of battle is gradually pushed forward. The Traders and Agent escorts move up, reclaiming the cargo.
units.displayText: With the combined arms of machine gun and assault rifle, the line of battle is gradually pushed forward. The Traders and Agent escorts move up, reclaiming the cargo.

spans.text: With the combined arms of machine gun and assault rifle, the line of battle is gradually pushed forward. The Traders and Agent escorts move up, reclaiming the cargo.

units.rawText: Clukay stares intently at the tail end of the Entropic mass, seemingly looking for something.
units.displayText: Clukay stares intently at the tail end of the Entropic mass, seemingly looking for something.

spans.text: Clukay stares intently at the tail end of the Entropic mass, seemingly looking for something.

units.rawText: Found it, Clukay! At the tail of the horde! The exact same data indicators!
units.displayText: Found it, Clukay! At the tail of the horde! The exact same data indicators!

spans.text: Found it, Clukay! At the tail of the horde! The exact same data indicators!

units.rawText: The Traders have already evacuated under Abigail, Jessie, and Yelena's cover.
units.displayText: The Traders have already evacuated under Abigail, Jessie, and Yelena's cover.

spans.text: The Traders have already evacuated under Abigail, Jessie, and Yelena's cover.

units.rawText: Confirmed here as well! Distance... approximately 1200m!
units.displayText: Confirmed here as well! Distance... approximately 1200m!

spans.text: Confirmed here as well! Distance... approximately 1200m!

units.rawText: Adjusting her visual module, Clukay finally gets a visual on the operation's target.
units.displayText: Adjusting her visual module, Clukay finally gets a visual on the operation's target.

spans.text: Adjusting her visual module, Clukay finally gets a visual on the operation's target.

units.rawText: The elegant High Order Entropic raises her staff high, commanding the Entropics' movements from the middle of the crowd.
units.displayText: The elegant High Order Entropic raises her staff high, commanding the Entropics' movements from the middle of the crowd.

spans.text: The elegant High Order Entropic raises her staff high, commanding the Entropics' movements from the middle of the crowd.

units.rawText: Target confirmed, operation phase 1 complete. Progressing to phase 2. Fire at will, I will take care of the enemy leader.
units.displayText: Target confirmed, operation phase 1 complete. Progressing to phase 2. Fire at will, I will take care of the enemy leader.

spans.text: Target confirmed, operation phase 1 complete. Progressing to phase 2. Fire at will, I will take care of the enemy leader.

units.rawText: She makes once last round of checks on the rifle in her hand.
units.displayText: She makes once last round of checks on the rifle in her hand.

spans.text: She makes once last round of checks on the rifle in her hand.

units.rawText: Limiters... off. Distance... 1200m. Target, Ptolemaea.
units.displayText: Limiters... off. Distance... 1200m. Target, Ptolemaea.

spans.text: Limiters... off. Distance... 1200m. Target, Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: Explosions rain down on the Entropics. Clukay rushes into the Entropic horde on her lonesome, carving a bloody path with overwhelming power.
units.displayText: Explosions rain down on the Entropics. Clukay rushes into the Entropic horde on her lonesome, carving a bloody path with overwhelming power.

spans.text: Explosions rain down on the Entropics. Clukay rushes into the Entropic horde on her lonesome, carving a bloody path with overwhelming power.

units.rawText: In but a blink, Clukay opens a direct path to the other side of the Entropic mass.
units.displayText: In but a blink, Clukay opens a direct path to the other side of the Entropic mass.

spans.text: In but a blink, Clukay opens a direct path to the other side of the Entropic mass.

units.rawText: What?! This speed...?!
units.displayText: What?! This speed...?!

spans.text: What?! This speed...?!

units.rawText: Clukay's killing intent obvious, Ptolemaea instinctively raises a tentacle to strike back.
units.displayText: Clukay's killing intent obvious, Ptolemaea instinctively raises a tentacle to strike back.

spans.text: Clukay's killing intent obvious, Ptolemaea instinctively raises a tentacle to strike back.

units.rawText: Clink—
units.displayText: Clink—

spans.text: Clink—

units.rawText: ...Ha... This is truly...
units.displayText: ...Ha... This is truly...

spans.text: ...Ha... This is truly...

units.rawText: She helplessly gazes into the black barrel of 416's weapon.
units.displayText: She helplessly gazes into the black barrel of 416's weapon.

spans.text: She helplessly gazes into the black barrel of 416's weapon.

units.rawText: The rifle and its underbarrel grenade launcher fire, making their mark on Ptolemaea's body.
units.displayText: The rifle and its underbarrel grenade launcher fire, making their mark on Ptolemaea's body.

spans.text: The rifle and its underbarrel grenade launcher fire, making their mark on Ptolemaea's body.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: Target, Ptolemaea's clone, confirmed.
units.displayText: Target, Ptolemaea's clone, confirmed.

spans.text: Target, Ptolemaea's clone, confirmed.

units.rawText: Cough, cough... most impressive. I do not believe... I have ever had a dance partner so powerful before.
units.displayText: Cough, cough... most impressive. I do not believe... I have ever had a dance partner so powerful before.

spans.text: Cough, cough... most impressive. I do not believe... I have ever had a dance partner so powerful before.

units.rawText: I had thought you were here to reinforce the Traders, but it would appear your target was me all along.
units.displayText: I had thought you were here to reinforce the Traders, but it would appear your target was me all along.

spans.text: I had thought you were here to reinforce the Traders, but it would appear your target was me all along.

units.rawText: Commander's orders. Uproot all of the clones, and prevent your true body from reviving someplace else.
units.displayText: Commander's orders. Uproot all of the clones, and prevent your true body from reviving someplace else.

spans.text: Commander's orders. Uproot all of the clones, and prevent your true body from reviving someplace else.

units.rawText: A wise decision... Hehehe, it would appear that my other clones and my main body are now in danger as well.
units.displayText: A wise decision... Hehehe, it would appear that my other clones and my main body are now in danger as well.

spans.text: A wise decision... Hehehe, it would appear that my other clones and my main body are now in danger as well.

units.rawText: A shame, then, that this body of yours is no suitable vessel for your capabilities.
units.displayText: A shame, then, that this body of yours is no suitable vessel for your capabilities.

spans.text: A shame, then, that this body of yours is no suitable vessel for your capabilities.

units.rawText: Clukay's rifle is aimed at Ptolemaea, but she cannot manage to pull the trigger.
units.displayText: Clukay's rifle is aimed at Ptolemaea, but she cannot manage to pull the trigger.

spans.text: Clukay's rifle is aimed at Ptolemaea, but she cannot manage to pull the trigger.

units.rawText: Small arcs of electricity bounce to and fro on Clukay's body.
units.displayText: Small arcs of electricity bounce to and fro on Clukay's body.

spans.text: Small arcs of electricity bounce to and fro on Clukay's body.

units.rawText: ...A civilian Doll's kit really is inconvenient. I get a little serious, and it's on the verge of overloading.
units.displayText: ...A civilian Doll's kit really is inconvenient. I get a little serious, and it's on the verge of overloading.

spans.text: ...A civilian Doll's kit really is inconvenient. I get a little serious, and it's on the verge of overloading.

units.rawText: A pity. If it ever be possible, I would have us meet and dance in our true forms...
units.displayText: A pity. If it ever be possible, I would have us meet and dance in our true forms...

spans.text: A pity. If it ever be possible, I would have us meet and dance in our true forms...

units.rawText: <size=40>Clukay!</size>
units.displayText: Clukay!

spans.text: Clukay!

units.rawText: <color=red>Take the shot, KSVK.</color>
units.displayText: Take the shot, KSVK.

spans.text: Take the shot, KSVK.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: The sound of a gunshot reverberates throughout the battlefield. The anti-materiel bullet puts this rescue operation to rest.
units.displayText: The sound of a gunshot reverberates throughout the battlefield. The anti-materiel bullet puts this rescue operation to rest.

spans.text: The sound of a gunshot reverberates throughout the battlefield. The anti-materiel bullet puts this rescue operation to rest.

units.rawText: ...A sniper... I see...
units.displayText: ...A sniper... I see...

spans.text: ...A sniper... I see...

units.rawText: The curtains must fall on this ball, then... Farewell, my most passionate dancer.
units.displayText: The curtains must fall on this ball, then... Farewell, my most passionate dancer.

spans.text: The curtains must fall on this ball, then... Farewell, my most passionate dancer.

units.rawText: How unfortunate... that I never learnt your name...
units.displayText: How unfortunate... that I never learnt your name...

spans.text: How unfortunate... that I never learnt your name...

units.rawText: Ptolemaea's body slowly melts, turning into a puddle of Entropic liquid.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea's body slowly melts, turning into a puddle of Entropic liquid.

spans.text: Ptolemaea's body slowly melts, turning into a puddle of Entropic liquid.

units.rawText: Phase 2 complete. The High Order Entropic Ptolemaea's clone has been eliminated.
units.displayText: Phase 2 complete. The High Order Entropic Ptolemaea's clone has been eliminated.

spans.text: Phase 2 complete. The High Order Entropic Ptolemaea's clone has been eliminated.

units.rawText: Griffin Squad, initiate phase 3... Eliminate all Entropics in the area.
units.displayText: Griffin Squad, initiate phase 3... Eliminate all Entropics in the area.

spans.text: Griffin Squad, initiate phase 3... Eliminate all Entropics in the area.
